HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

15. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
